name: C073 Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã (Quyền Trượng Đôi Cánh Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of an Epic dark-fantasy Fallen Angel's dual-wing sanctuary scepter staff (Quyền Trượng Đôi Cánh Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã - C073 Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete seraphic staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (fluted obsidian-and-platinum shaft) to top-right (an asymmetrical twin-winged crest: one radiant golden-white angel wing and one dark obsidian-slate fallen wing embracing a blazing golden-amber sacred heart shield crystal).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom spike to top winged halo with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use celestial gold, platinum silver, dark obsidian feathers, and radiant amber-white holy barrier light).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Fallen Angel Dual-Wing Scepter Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal winged scepter at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame celestial barrier aura: radiant golden-white divine shield ripples and floating golden-and-obsidian spectral feathers pulsing around the winged heart crystal.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Fallen Angel Dual-Wing Scepter Staff (Quyền Trượng Đôi Cánh Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã - C073 Thiên Sứ Sa Ngã) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the dual-winged golden-and-obsidian scepter staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a ruined cathedral beneath a dramatic eclipse where a dome of golden-white seraphic shield light and drifting feathers bursts from the staff.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
